# A grid built with locked columns never syncs row hover across regions

## Context

Found while fixing #19820, recorded as a defect-note at 15:35Z, and promoted by triage after a real-browser check. On the issues showcase, at dev `eedc33c3dd` plus #19821 (which only adds destroy-time retirement), hovering a row breaks the highlight at both locked seams:
- Hovering row 3's center cells tints them `rgb(250, 249, 253)`.
- The same row's locked-start cell (`19756`) and locked-end cell (`Open`) stay `rgb(255, 255, 255)`.
- On the main thread, `Neo.main.addon.GridRowHoverSync` is not even loaded. `GridDragScroll` and `GridRowScrollPinning` each hold one registration for the same grid.

## The Problem

#9630 made `GridRowHoverSync` sync a row's hover across the start, center and end bodies whenever the grid has locked columns. It registers through `Container#updateColCount`, inside `if (me.scrollManager)` (`src/grid/Container.mjs:1637`). A grid with locked columns in its initial config only calls `updateColCount()` from `construct` (`:359`). That is before `onConstructed` creates the `ScrollManager` (`:1307–1312`), so the block is skipped. `ScrollManager#afterSetMounted` registers drag scroll, row pinning and horizontal scroll sync, but not hover sync. Only a later column change (`onColumnsMutate`, `:1300`) registers it. #19820's unit recorder shows the same thing: a grid created with a locked column has no hover-sync registration after mount, and a runtime lock adds one.

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: #9630, which introduced hover sync so that hovering a row highlights its cells in every region.
- `GridRowHoverSync#register` silently skips a view whose DOM node is absent (`src/main/addon/GridRowHoverSync.mjs:116–138`). A registration attempted before mount does nothing, so registration belongs to the mount lifecycle.
- `ScrollManager` already owns the mount lifecycle of its other addons in `afterSetMounted` and `afterSetWindowId` (`src/grid/ScrollManager.mjs:110–151`).

## The Fix

- `ScrollManager#afterSetMounted` registers `GridRowHoverSync` on mount when `rowHoverSync` is on and the grid has locked columns, and retires it on unmount.
- `afterSetWindowId` moves it with the others.
- `Container#updateColCount` keeps toggling it when columns are locked or unlocked at run time.
- No config or API change.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A grid constructed with locked columns registers `GridRowHoverSync` when it mounts. (Unit test, red on dev.)
- [ ] In the issues showcase, hovering a center row also tints that row's locked start and end cells. (Real browser, both seams.)
- [ ] Unmount retires the registration, and a lock change while mounted still registers or retires it.
- [ ] A grid without locked columns registers no hover sync (negative control).

## Out of Scope

- The addon's own behaviour, since it syncs correctly once registered.
- Destroy-time retirement, which is #19820.
